bullets.text: Google Photos Feature Restricted - **Google**'s new AI photo editing feature is unavailable in Texas and Illinois due to biometric laws.
Apple's Legal Woes Continue - **Apple** denied permission to appeal a billion-dollar lawsuit from UK developers over app commissions.
Mastodon Restructures Leadership - **Mastodon**'s CEO steps down as the platform transitions to a non-profit model for sustainability.
Peec AI's Rapid Growth - **Peec AI** raises $21M to help brands adapt as consumers shift from **Google** to **ChatGPT** for product discovery.
Apple Watch Feature Under Scrutiny - The redesigned Blood Oxygen feature on the **Apple Watch** faces new scrutiny from the ITC.
New AirDrop Feature in iOS 26.2 - **Apple** introduces a one-time code feature for **AirDrop** in the latest iOS update.
Google's AI Weather Model Launched - **Google** rolls out its new AI weather model, promising faster and more accurate forecasts.
DoorDash Data Breach Confirmed - **DoorDash** reveals a data breach affecting users' personal information, including addresses.
Cisco Acquires EzDubs - **Cisco** acquires **EzDubs**, enhancing its communication platform with real-time translation capabilities.
Ford Partners with Amazon - **Ford** teams up with **Amazon** to boost certified used car sales through Amazon Autos.
